source.citation: N. Pauly, F. Yubero, S. Tougaard, ELF dielectric functions for various materials, Zenodo, Version 1.0 (2022-02-09).
source.original_reference: F. Yubero, S. Tougaard, Physical Review B 46, 2486 (1992).

bulk_usage.scope: Homogeneous bulk DIIMFP example only. It does not reproduce or compare against QUEELS-XPS.

notes: Preserves the source strengths in eV^2 without rescaling. Width is the oscillator damping parameter in eV and dispersion is dimensionless.
The source file contains material parameters. It specifies no calculation conditions or normalization procedure.

The file gives refractive index 999 without defining it. The empty manual form also shows 999 and ac = 0.001, bc = -2 (v2.1, p. 25, Fig. 8). The optical sum-rule audit uses 999 as the literal n in 1 - 1/n^2.
Yubero2005 uses different Al oscillator energy and strength. See docs/BENCHMARK_INPUTS.md.
